scope.counterfactual: Illinois Medicaid and other payers continue to fund eligible enrollees.
scope.templateFitNote: Org attachment is nominal: YMCA of Metropolitan Chicago's own DPP price and status were not found.

extraKg.label: Additional weight loss versus offer-only control
extraKg.rationale: Randomized YMCA offer trial, with scenario spread.

sources.title: Ackermann et al.: randomized YMCA offer trial

discountedRetentionYears.label: Discounted years over which the weight difference persists
discountedRetentionYears.rationale: Sum over years t of retention[t]/1.03^(t+0.5) for the SF retention profiles [0.25,0.25], [0.5,1,0.75,0.25] and [0.5,1,1,1,1,0.5]. Embeds the 3% discount convention; a v2 template should split persistence from discounting.

sources.title: Kuo et al.: prospective NDPP cost and QALY analysis

utilityPerKg.label: QALY weight gain per kg of weight loss per year

sources.title: Ackermann et al.: weight change and health utility

costPerParticipant.label: Donor cost per additional enrolled participant
costPerParticipant.rationale: Central = a Berwyn, IL YMCA flyer price of $475 per year (undated, a different Y association than YMCA of Metro Chicago). Price, not cost; bounds are judgment.

fundingAdditionality.label: Share of donor-funded enrollment that would not otherwise be funded
fundingAdditionality.rationale: Illinois Medicaid covers National DPP (coverage from 2021; fee-for-service claims opened Aug 2024) for members aged 18 to 64, similar to Medi-Cal in SF, so the SF distribution is kept.

sources.title: Provider notice: diabetes prevention and DSMES claims

transfer.label: Retention of trial effect in the local population and provider
transfer.rationale: Transferred unchanged from SF; provider recognition status not looked up.

nativeOutcome.unit: discounted kg-years of incremental weight loss

outcomesPer10kUsd.unit: discounted kg-years of incremental weight loss per $10,000

costPerOutcome.unit: USD per discounted kg-years of incremental weight loss

qalysPerNativeOutcome.unit: QALYs per discounted kg-years of incremental weight loss

qalyLayer.notes: probabilityNonPositive is 0 by construction: v1 input distributions are strictly positive, so the null case lives only in nullBoundary.

simulation.notes: Inputs drawn independently. Legacy SF scenarios were joint corners; independent draws give a narrower price spread than those corners.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: Whether YMCA of Metro Chicago runs a CDC-recognized DPP now, its price, and unfunded seats.

nullBoundary: If the cohort would have been funded anyway or weight loss does not persist, benefit is zero and there is no finite price.
